instruction:
Two Storey Meeting Center Retrofit IFC

This task starts from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc and uses the local reference image C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_sheet.png. In Revit, modify the starting model into a two-storey meeting center scheme and export the completed model as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc in the Desktop.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc is at least 500 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities, 5 IfcSpace entities, 12 IfcWall entities, 3 IfcSlab entities, and 5 IfcCurtainWall entities.
5. The IFC model contains 0 IfcRoof, 0 IfcDoor, 0 IfcWindow, 0 IfcStair, 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, and 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy entities.
6. After replacing hyphens and underscores with spaces and lowercasing names, the IfcSpace name list contains the token lobby at least once and meeting at least 4 times.
7. After the same normalization, the IfcSpace name list contains the exact space name central lobby at least once.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
